convert_polys_to_mask: convert COCO polygon segmentation format to a binary mask encoded as a 2D numpy float32 array
flip_segms_left_right: left/right flip each mask in a list of masks supporting both polygon and RLE formats
compute_mask_bbox: compute the tight bounding box of a binary mask and return coordinates as a numpy array
perform_mask_nms: perform greedy non-maximum suppression on RLE masks using IOU, IOMA, or CONTAINMENT overlap measurement modes
vote_overlapping_masks: combine multiple overlapping RLE masks using weighted average or union methods with configurable IoU threshold
